messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — want to map out a tiny DP 'mini-journey' pilot for onboarding + scope negotiation. goal: validate two onboarding paths and firm up launch gates for beta cohorts.
Owen (Eng): ok define the two paths?
Maya (PM): Path A = concierge-assisted onboarding (SE session + prefilled config). Path B = self-serve guided flow (Console quickstart + checklist). run as randomized DP experiment.
Harpreet (CS): concierge likely reduces churn for complex infra partners. we should reserve Path A for partners flagged as high-touch in intake.
Zoe (DevEx): I'll build a guided checklist modal for Path B and a 'request SE' button. checklist steps: create key, quick sample call, validate schema, optional survey.
Elliot (Data): events: dp_signup, path_assigned, se_requested, quickstart_clicked, auth_failed, sample_passed, survey_score. cohort tag dp=true.
Owen (Eng): engineering concerns: auth friction and model pinning are the top causes of delays for DP. add an auth detector to trigger immediate help.
Maya (PM): agreed — adaptive auth nudge for both paths. also capture the scope negotiation point: partners can declare 'must-have' vs 'nice-to-have' features during intake; we'll log those.
Harpreet (CS): recommend we offer a small incentive for completing integration within 14 days: $500 credit or co-marketing feature. increases commitment.
Zoe (DevEx): we'll include opt-in for co-marketing and a short consent checkbox in the intake modal. copy draft will be shared.
Elliot (Data): primary metric: % partners with sample_passed within 14 days. secondary: median time-to-pass, survey mean (1-5), number of scope items downgraded after negotiation, and CS ticket rate within 30 days. target: +40% primary for Path A vs control, Path B target +25%.
Maya (PM): launch gates for full cohort rollout: 1) primary metric uplift with p<0.05 for chosen path OR concierge reduces open CS tickets by 50% within 30 days; 2) no increase in per-request cost >5%; 3) no latency regression; 4) legal/compliance signoff for co-marketing.
Owen (Eng): we'll feature-flag both paths. estimate: Path B quickstart + checklist + events = 4 dev-days; auth detector + adaptive routing = 1 day; SE scheduling hook = small.
Harpreet (CS): we need an intake rubric to classify high-touch vs low-touch DP. I'll draft triage rules (infra complexity, data sensitivity, number of expected users).
Zoe (DevEx): timeline: prototype checklist + intake modal in 5 business days; SE slot booking + confirmation email in 2 days after that.
Elliot (Data): I'll prepare an analysis workbook for A/B and conversion funnels. need event names by EOD.
Maya (PM): timeline: prep this week, pilot launch next Monday for 3 weeks. reconvene after two weeks of data for interim review.
NexusBot: experiment record created: dp_mini_journey_v1. CI checks: passing. :white_check_mark:
Maya (PM): action items: Owen send event schema + FF hooks; Zoe draft checklist + intake modal copy; Harpreet draft triage rubric and incentive language; Elliot build analysis spec; I'll coordinate DP invites and partner incentives. Preflight Fri 09:00. Thanks all. :rocket:
